t: Photosynthesis in the Ear of Barley | Nature
s: THE ear of cereals such as barley and wheat is an important photosynthetic organ in providing carbohydrate substrate for grain filling. This has been established by several workers, most recently by Archbold1 for barley and Asana and Mani2 for wheat. Their technique, as of previous workers, involved opaque shading of the ear to prevent photosynthesis, the resulting reduction in grain weight being taken to represent the normal ear contribution.
